display.purpose: Authoritative civic hero titles and section banners.

ui.purpose: Navigation tabs, status badges, and uppercase category tags.

body.purpose: Neutral, highly legible text for long-form reading and tables.

mono.purpose: Statutory tender IDs, coordinates, and cryptographic verification receipts.

shadows.name: structural-none
shadows.purpose: Surfaces are flat at rest; depth is created via contrasting tonal layers.

motion.name: ease-out-decelerate
motion.purpose: Calm, dignified state transitions without bouncy overshoot.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Rectilinear civic commitment button with high-contrast text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #294f46; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1e3b34; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #294f46; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Outline Button
components.description: Transparent action button anchored by a 1px stone border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #232b29; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #d7ddd7; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e7ebe5; border-color: #232b29; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #294f46; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge (Officially Sanctioned)
components.description: Two-state decoupling badge for funded and gazetted public projects.
components.css: .ds-badge-sanctioned { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; background: rgba(41, 79, 70, 0.1); color: #294f46; border: 1px solid rgba(41, 79, 70, 0.3); font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; } .ds-dot-green { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #294f46; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Status Badge (Proposed Initiative)
components.description: Decoupled badge for citizen proposals awaiting statutory sanction.
components.css: .ds-badge-proposed { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; background: rgba(179, 140, 109, 0.12); color: #946c48; border: 1px solid rgba(179, 140, 109, 0.35); font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; } .ds-dot-amber { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #b38c6d; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Civic Record Card
components.description: Solid white card bed with 1px stone border and rectilinear geometry.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d7ddd7; padding: 24px; border-radius: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #232b29; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: Public Sans, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #47544f; }

narrative.overview:
Mayang Imphal employs a Nordic Lagom Minimalist aesthetic rooted in architectural restraint, civic gravitas, and honest communication. Lagom rejects empty tech decoration, artificial urgency, and AI visual clichés in favor of calm, high-contrast, editorial clarity.

Every layout is built on a rectilinear grid with zero rounded corners (rounded-none), evoking statutory municipal charters, town planning maps, and physical civic monuments. The interface recedes to let verified public records, scholarship deadlines, and spatial planning layers lead.
keyCharacteristics: Rectilinear Geometry: Strict rounded: 0px across all buttons, cards, containers, and badges.
Nordic Pine & Stone Palette: Warm limestone parchment, deep forest pine accents, and quiet dividing lines.
Dual-Status Clarity: Clear visual separation between official state tenders and community proposals.
Architectural Typography: Oswald for authoritative headlines, Montserrat for uppercase navigation, Public Sans for body text.

rules.name: The Rarity of Pine Rule
rules.body: Primary pine fills are reserved for primary action commitments, key progress badges, and navigation focal points. At least 85% of the viewport remains neutral stone and crisp white.

rules.name: The No-Faux-Heritage Rule
rules.body: Never use simulated parchment stains, skeuomorphic crests, or artificial antique gradients. Dignity comes from geometric precision and honest data.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: Functional text and labels never fall below 11px. Micro-text smaller than 11px is prohibited to ensure full WCAG 2.2 accessibility.

rules.name: The Dual-Font Nav Rule
rules.body: Navigation items pair Montserrat uppercase labels (tracking-wider) with Public Sans descriptive subtitles.

dos: Do ground every civic claim with a verifiable tender reference, department notice, or official citation.
Do maintain strict dual-status decoupling between community proposals and sanctioned public works.
Do enforce minimum 44×44px interactive touch targets and visible focus indicators.
Do keep functional UI text at or above the 11px accessibility floor.
Do keep interactive button and card edges rectilinear (rounded-none).
donts: Don't use purple-to-cyan gradients, dark glowing halos, or floating spotlights.
Don't nest cards within cards (avoid container-in-container visual bloat).
Don't use bouncy or rubber-band animations; use subtle ease-out deceleration.
Don't reduce functional UI text below 11px.
Don't hide important statutory disclaimers in tiny unreadable smallprint.
